hajjPage.hajjOfferTitle: Hajj 1447 AH with Nidaa Hajj & Umrah Campaign
hajjPage.hajjOfferDescription: The campaign known for continuous development of its services, registers itself in this season 1447 AH as the first Omani campaign to stay in Mina in the new Mina hotel towers (Keddana). You are on a date with hotel accommodation in the holy sites!
hajjPage.hajjOfferAccommodation: 5-star hotels + Keddana Hotel Towers in Mina
features: Luxurious services befitting people of refined taste.
Accommodation in five and four-star hotels in Makkah, Medina and Jeddah.
Reception and hospitality at Makkah Clock Royal Tower Fairmont Hotel (Clock Tower) 5 stars, overlooking the Holy Mosque.
Accommodation in Mina outside the Omani camp, in Mina hotel towers (Keddana Valley).
Accommodation in Arafat outside the Omani camp in a private royal camp with full services.
Buffet meals for three meals throughout the trip.
Contract with a shipping company for luggage shipping and transportation.
Use of Haramain High Speed Railway from Medina to Makkah.
First Omani campaign to use the Mashaaer train to transport pilgrims during Tashreeq days.
Comprehensive program for preaching, religious guidance, and ritual study.
Medical service and comprehensive administrative follow-up.

flight.content: Flight on Oman Air: Muscat - Medina on 2026/5/21 | Jeddah - Muscat on 2026/5/31

items: Reception of pilgrims at Medina airport and transfer to accommodation by modern buses
Accommodation in a five-star hotel near the Prophet's Mosque
Luxurious buffets for three meals throughout the stay
Visit to Quba Mosque and prayer there, visit to Mount Uhud, and passing by historical places in Medina
Shipping pilgrims' luggage to Makkah in the evening before departure day, so it arrives before them at their accommodation in Makkah
Departure from Medina to Makkah via Haramain High Speed Railway
Our Hajj program allows you to choose the type of ritual you want, so you can be Mutamatti, Qarin, or Mufrid
Reception and hospitality at Makkah Clock Royal Tower Fairmont Hotel (Clock Tower) 5 stars, overlooking the Holy Mosque, and dinner with a luxurious buffet at the hotel restaurant
Fairmont Makkah Clock Tower lounge is the gathering point after performing Umrah

Staying in Makkah at Time Ruba Hotel, a 4-star hotel with 5-star services. It is distinguished by its luxury, magnificent architecture, and the spaciousness of its rooms, corridors, and facilities, along with strong and outstanding management.
Accommodation in Mina at Keddana Hotel Towers
Large Mina-style rooms air-conditioned with the highest level of comfort and cleanliness
Elegant private bathrooms for Keddana Towers, each floor has its own bathrooms
Prayer room on each floor and private rest areas
Three meals with international luxury buffet, drinks and snacks throughout the day
Continuous religious supervision and daily guidance for Hajj rituals
Medical service and comprehensive administrative follow-up
Private Arafat camp to feel the spirituality of Arafat day with distinguished organization and preparation
The camp is equipped with a dining area, prayer area, and elegant clean bathrooms
Providing meals for main meals, cold and hot drinks and snacks
Muzdalifah rest stop
Transportation between holy sites by modern air-conditioned buses
Overnight stay in Mina at Mina towers at night, and pilgrims can stay at the hotel in Makkah during the day for more comfort
Use of Mashaaer train on Eid day and Tashreeq days to enter Mina and stone the Jamarat, if regulations permit

jeddah.content: One night in Jeddah before returning home according to flight booking circumstances

items: The price includes:
International travel ticket in economy class, and for upgrade to business class add 250 OMR
Accommodation in Medina and Jeddah in double rooms
Accommodation in Makkah in triple rooms, and to upgrade the room in Makkah to double pay an additional 450 OMR per person
Accommodation in Mina in shared rooms
Train ticket economy class, and for upgrade to business class (increase not specified)
